blurb:
Experience Niagara Falls the smart way on this small-group day tour from Toronto.

With a maximum of 12 guests (often fewer), you’ll enjoy a more relaxed, personal experience — no crowded buses, no long waits, and more time at the Falls.

Travel in comfort in an air-conditioned minibus as your local guide (with 7+ years of experience) shares real stories, hidden viewpoints, and insider tips you won’t get on larger tours.

Your day includes the iconic Niagara boat cruise (seasonal), scenic stops along the Niagara Parkway, and free time to explore the Falls at your own pace.
